meta.title: Insu — Breathe. If it happens, we pay you.
meta.description: Fixed-price, fixed-payout protection against traffic, bad-air days, heavy rain and gas price spikes. No paperwork: if it happens, we pay you.

footer.notInsurer: Insu is not an insurance company.
footer.disclaimer: Insu is a technology platform for parametric contracts. Our protections pay a fixed amount when public, verifiable data crosses a line set in advance; they don't depend on, or indemnify, any actual loss.

howItWorks.title: Breathe. If it happens, we pay you.
howItWorks.intro: Insu protects you against everyday things that can be measured: traffic on your route, a bad-air day, heavy rain or expensive gas. You pay a fixed price; if the data crosses the line, we pay you a fixed amount.
howItWorks.fact1Body: The price depends on how likely it is to happen, the period you choose and the pool available. It's recalculated once a day.
howItWorks.fact2Body: Google Maps for traffic, OpenWeatherMap for air and rain, CRE and Guatemala's Ministry of Energy and Mines for gas.
howItWorks.fact3Body: You don't have to prove a loss or fill in forms. If the data crosses the line during your period, the payout is processed on its own.
howItWorks.fact4Body: You can see prices in your currency, but charges and payouts are made in US dollars.
howItWorks.earnBody: People who provide capital to a pool keep the fees when the event doesn't happen, and cover the payouts when it does.
